title: openmmcli build manifest
description: Describes an OCI image: annotations, base images to inherit, paths to copy, and a local assets directory.

from.description: Registry reference(s) or local OCI layout path(s) whose layers are inherited in order.

copy.description: Extract specific paths from a source image and add them as a new layer.

assets.description: Local directory packed as the top layer (relative to this file).

gen.description: Generation recipe: lane, provider, model, and parameters. Baked into the image config blob so `openmmcli gen <ref>` can run it. Never contains credentials.

provider.description: Provider id, optionally with model: 'zhipu' or 'zhipu/cogview-3-flash'.

prompt.description: Default prompt (overridable via the positional prompt at gen time).

image.description: Reference image: http(s)/data URL, local path, or pkg://path into the package layers.

firstFrame.description: Video first frame / reference image: URL, local path, or pkg://path.

lastFrame.description: Video last frame: URL, local path, or pkg://path.

input.description: Attachment(s) for understand (URL/local path/pkg://path), or text(s) to embed.
